exact_parity.method: Exact rational equality at unit mass and renormalization scale in authenticated FMFT master basis; no epsilon truncation or floating tolerance

protocol.mode_order: alternating between repetitions; sequential, never overlapping
protocol.scope: First public evaluate_integral call in a fresh process; retained masters, common symbolic mUVsq and FMFTandMATAD normalization. Excludes engine/data loading, cache attachment, input parsing and validation. FMFT includes version check, process launch, reduction, I/O and output parsing. Cache chunks are cold in-process; OS pages are not flushed.

five_loop_dot_ingress_acceptance.measurement_kind: Debug exact acceptance measurement; not a release performance benchmark

protocol.graph_schedule: Sequential; reserved CPU affinity is not observed parallel utilization
protocol.scope: Native FeynKit parsing, exact family-to-graph checks, complete numerator checks, Vakint ingress and native DOT round trips for all 640 masters. Excludes subsequent package loading, IBP reduction, numerical master evaluation and cache preparation. Shared host; filesystem cache not flushed.
protocol.reproduction_example: cargo run --locked -p vakint --example external_data_acceptance --features feynkit-ingress,experimental-rustred -- DATA NEW_REPORT --graphs-only
